Prompt

Create a professional catering services page for a restaurant called "Savory Affairs Catering" that handles corporate events, weddings, and private parties. Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Full-width background image of an elegantly plated catering spread
- Headline: "Unforgettable Events Start With Exceptional Food"
- Subheadline: "Corporate events, weddings, and private parties — tailored menus for 20 to 500 guests"
- Primary CTA: "Request a Quote"
- Secondary CTA: "Browse Sample Menus"
- Subtle parallax scroll effect on the background image

2. SERVICES OVERVIEW (3-column card layout)
- Corporate Events
  - Board meetings, product launches, company picnics
  - Icon: briefcase
  - Starting at $35/person
- Weddings & Receptions
  - Rehearsal dinners, ceremony receptions, brunch send-offs
  - Icon: rings/heart
  - Starting at $75/person
- Private Parties
  - Birthdays, anniversaries, holiday gatherings
  - Icon: champagne glass
  - Starting at $45/person
- Each card has a subtle hover lift effect with box-shadow transition

3. SAMPLE MENUS SECTION
- Tabbed interface with 3 menu tiers:
  - Classic Package ($35/person): Caesar salad, grilled chicken breast, roasted seasonal vegetables, garlic bread, choice of dessert
  - Premium Package ($55/person): Burrata & heirloom tomato, pan-seared salmon or filet mignon, truffle mashed potatoes, artisan bread basket, tiramisu or crème brûlée
  - Luxury Package ($85/person): Oyster bar & charcuterie spread, lobster tail or wagyu strip steak, risotto with wild mushrooms, imported cheese course, custom dessert station
- Note below: "All menus fully customizable. Dietary accommodations available (vegan, gluten-free, kosher, halal)."

4. HOW IT WORKS (4-step horizontal timeline)
- Step 1: "Tell Us About Your Event" — Fill out the inquiry form with date, guest count, and preferences
- Step 2: "Menu Consultation" — Our chef designs a custom menu tailored to your vision
- Step 3: "Tasting Session" — Sample your curated menu before the big day
- Step 4: "We Handle Everything" — Setup, service, and cleanup included
- Each step has a numbered circle icon with a connecting line between them

5. PAST EVENTS GALLERY
- 6-image masonry grid showing beautifully styled events
- Categories: Corporate, Wedding, Private labeled as subtle badges on each image
- Lightbox on click for full-size viewing
- Caption below each: event type, guest count, venue name

6. TESTIMONIALS
- 3 client reviews displayed in a carousel/slider
  - "Savory Affairs made our wedding reception absolutely magical. Every guest raved about the food." — Sarah & James, 200-guest wedding
  - "We've used them for 3 corporate events now. Always professional, always delicious." — Michael R., VP of Operations at TechCorp
  - "The custom vegan menu they created blew everyone away." — Priya K., 50th birthday celebration
- Star ratings (all 5 stars) and verified badge

7. INQUIRY FORM
- Headline: "Let's Plan Your Event"
- Fields: Full name, email, phone, event type (dropdown: Corporate, Wedding, Private Party, Other), estimated guest count (number input), preferred date (date picker), venue location, additional notes (textarea)
- Submit button: "Get Your Custom Quote"
- Note: "We respond within 24 hours"

8. FAQ ACCORDION
- "How far in advance should I book?" — We recommend 4-6 weeks for private events, 3-6 months for weddings
- "Do you provide staff and equipment?" — Yes, full-service catering includes servers, bartenders, linens, and tableware
- "Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?" — Absolutely. We offer vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, kosher, and halal options
- "What is your cancellation policy?" — Full refund 30+ days out, 50% refund 14-29 days, no refund under 14 days
- "Do you offer tastings?" — Complimentary tasting for events over 75 guests

9. FOOTER
- Quick links: Services, Sample Menus, Gallery, Contact
- Phone: (555) 234-5678
- Email: events@savoryaffairs.com
- Social media: Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest
- Service area: "Proudly serving the Greater Metro area and surrounding counties"

Design: Warm, sophisticated palette — deep charcoal (#2D2D2D) backgrounds with cream (#FFF8F0) text sections, gold (#C9A84C) accents for CTAs and highlights. Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headings, Inter for body. Rounded corners (8px) on cards, subtle shadow depth. Mobile responsive with stacked cards and collapsible menus on small screens.
